summary: Iteration 7 covers the 3 new features: real Gmail SMTP invites, project image upload, and DnD dashboard-config persistence. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass — SMTP actually delivers (email_sent=true observed on live invite via smtp.gmail.com with sales@agrocorp.co.in app password), POST /projects/{id}/image works (multipart→file store→public /api/files/{id}/download returns image bytes with image/* content-type, project.image_url is patched), non-existent project → 404, non-admin roles → 403, GET/PATCH /me/dashboard-config persists exactly (including empty array). Regression endpoints intact (/dashboard/summary, /users, /projects, /revenue-targets, auth flow). Frontend: Dashboard customizer popover (dashboard-customize-btn) shows all 7 widget rows (kpis, variance, revenue_target, inventory_bar, expense_pie, expense_trend, vendors) each with a Switch + drag handle + Reset button; toggling Vendor Spend off updates aria-checked and PERSISTS across page reload (verified). Only critical UI miss: the Projects edit dialog is missing the promised project-image-input file input entirely — Projects.jsx defines an uploadImage() helper but never renders <input type='file'> in the DialogContent (0 file inputs in DOM). SMTP is real, so I limited invite tests to 3 plus-alias emails (sales+iter7t*@agrocorp.co.in).

ui_bugs.issue: Missing project-image-input file input and project-image-preview element. uploadImage() function exists in Projects.jsx (line 62) but is never wired to any <input type='file'>. 0 file inputs found in DOM when Edit dialog is open. Card thumbnail cannot be updated from UI.

action_items: Add file input inside Projects edit Dialog (inside DialogContent, likely after target_revenue/description) with data-testid='project-image-input' that calls uploadImage(editing.project_id, file). Also render a preview . The uploadImage() logic itself is already correct — just missing UI wiring.
Optional: gate the file input on `editing` being truthy (create-mode has no project_id yet so upload must be deferred until after create).
critical_code_review_comments: Projects.jsx: uploadImage function defined but no consumer — dead code from a UI perspective. Ship the input, or the whole feature is missing.
download_file (server.py L1560): sensible pattern that supports Bearer / Cookie / ?auth query. Good for embedding in for private files. is_public bypass is correct.
upload_project_image: image_url stored as relative /api/... path — frontend already resolves it via API_BASE prefix. Consistent with the rest of the app.
DashboardCustomizer save() catches errors but keeps optimistic local state — a failed PATCH will silently diverge from server. Consider re-fetching or reverting order on toast.error.

Backend pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; session-scoped admin_token fixture will run per xdist worker, causing race on must_reset_password → 'Current password is incorrect'. Fixed in iter7 test by trying rotated password first (idempotent). Recommend admin fixture pattern be documented for future iterations.
